message: たった一人の女の子

name: Sally
message: 「She said she had filming again today, so she went on ahead」

name: Sally
message: 「Apparently, she's searching for the elusive Tennoji-san」
Suddenly, I felt like I wanted to see Azel.

name: Sally
message: 「Something wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I see. Got it」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't look so down. I'll let Master Synn bang me anyti--」

name: Sally
message: 「The President's slapstick comebacks are always intense, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Only toward Paqy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And you know, 'Kirara' was just so amazing!」
Nanaka was acting strangely hyper.
Seeing her like that made me feel awful.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kirara finally ended up becoming the cult leader」
Still, the reason Nanaka was acting like this was my fault.
That's why I have to put an end to it.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, you really wouldn't expect it to suddenly turn into a drama about internal strife in a new religion, right」
I took a deep breath and let it out.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Out of nowhere?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, wait, maybe that 'sorry' is for something else!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it's just what you're guessing, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Hey, don't you think you could think it over a little more?」

name: Synn
message: 「Back then, I couldn't accept your confession, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's just because it came out of the blue and surprised you, right?」
I'm sure Nanaka already knows.
Or maybe she already knew.

name: Synn
message: 「There was a bit of that too, but... that's not it」
Searching carefully for the right words,

name: Synn
message: 「I do like you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop phrasing it like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know what you mean, but right now, it's just a bit much」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't need to apologize」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh. I just can't accept it. Something's holding me back」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not that anything's wrong with you, Nanaka--it's strictly an issue on my end」

name: Synn
message: 「My heart is already completely full of one girl」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I knew it」

name: Synn
message: 「You knew?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen here. You might not have realized it yourself, but it was totally obvious!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It was?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on! Ever since around the end of Kirafes, you've been fussing over Azel at every single opportunity!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And on top of that, you eagerly go pick her up, have one-on-one study sessions, start living together, cook every meal for her, and go on cozy outings together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You do this, you do that, you do everything! If that's not blatantly obvious, then what the heck is?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Living together... We just happen to live in the same apartment building. And what's with 'this, that, and everything'...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut your trap! I won't recognize anything other than your right to remain silent!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Got it? You have a duty to sit there and let me complain at you all I want!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's totally absurd. Still, I get how she feels.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck, what the heck! I've been with you since we were born, and our parents are close,」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus we live in the same neighborhood, caused mischief together, played around nonstop, and God even blessed our good everyday behavior by always putting us in the same school and the same class,」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I diligently fed you, even got the ultimate mandate from your parents telling me to take care of you, and even chased after you to join the Student Council!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It was?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you acting surprised now, you squash-headed pumpkin of an eccentric blockhead, you dirty rat! Normally anyone would notice!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me noticed, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh no! I was a carrot?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Carrot or burdock root, either way you're definitely not sharp, you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, because you were such a blockhead, I totally let my guard down, and carelessness is the greatest enemy--up in flames! Some newcomer who showed up three months ago brilliantly snatched the prize right out from under me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Agh, jeez, jeez! Nothing could be more frustrating! Got it?! You blockheaded nitwit!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haa, haa, wheeze, wheeze...」
Nanaka suddenly clapped her hands together twice.

name: Nanaka
message: 「All done, all done」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whew. Saying everything I wanted to say made me feel so refreshed!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen up! You dumped me, so you'd better pull your weight to make up for it!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good then. See ya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... Nanaka! Where are you going?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Today, I'm gonna stuff my face with sweets all day long! People call this stress-eating!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? Two people are absent today?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, noo, Sis! Stop iiit!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm Nana-chan's substitute~」

name: Misa
message: 「Can you do math?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoooa! Getting squeezed out that much! Truly rocket tits! Ria-chan is the best!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「As long as it's within what I can count on my fingers, I've got it covered~」

name: Misa
message: 「Haah...」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, make sure you pass this along to Azel-chan and Sally-chan for me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, no, auuun! Ah, kufuu! Stop it!」
Azel seems busy, though I should be able to catch her at the apartment.
Or rather, I'm sure I can catch her.

name: Synn
message: 「Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, why even Sally-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haah... It is troublesome without the treasurer. Our straight-man power is diminished.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why the heck would ya say that!」

name: Misa
message: 「Throwing in a retort for no reason doesn't help, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Give it a rest already!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, regarding the matter I need to inform you all about--」

name: Helena
message: 「Effective immediately today, the school patrol duties carried out by the Crusaders are hereby terminated.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is that!」

name: Helena
message: 「With less than half a month left until the Holy Night Festival, I need all of you in the Student Council to devote your full efforts to festival preparations.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aww, man. Guess going around eating sweets with Nana-chan is a no-go, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're awfully carefree. Isn't the Sweets Club running a maid cafe too?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh! Now that you mention it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, just last night--」
Helena-san placed a single sealed envelope on the desk.
Written in neat, if somewhat high―strung handwriting―

name: Misa
message: 「A letter of resignation?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The chairwoman is resigning from being the chairwoman! Vice President, it is your time to shine!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, what grand ambitions you have.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, that's not it! Besides, it clearly says Seira Sengenin on it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sengenin-sensei is...?」

name: Helena
message: 「It was sitting on my desk in the faculty room this morning」

name: Synn
message: 「...Could it be that Professor Sengen'in was a Demon too?」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about! She's strict, sure, but she's a wonderful teacher!」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan is right. What's more, she's one of the Seven Demon Generals」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Newcomers really are suspicious after all~ As a rule of thumb~」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's just a coincidence」

name: Helena
message: 「She and Pasta-chan infiltrated the academy and were commanding those Demons. Now that the two of them have vanished, it's safe to assume large-scale Demon activity at this academy is over」
Azel isn't here... I thought I'd find him if I looked here, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you know what book this cover belongs to?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hmm... I'm afraid I couldn't say. However, it does not appear to be from this library's collection, at least」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It looks burned, though--where did you find it?」

name: Synn
message: 「It was lying in the courtyard. It looked like the cover of an expensive book, so I thought it'd be bad if it belonged to the library」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you're looking for Azel-san, he hasn't come in today either」

name: Synn
message: 「Is... that so...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Has something happened?」
I can just see him back at the apartment.
There's no way he wouldn't come home, after all.
The past few days were just a coincidence.

name: Melilot
message: 「May I hold onto this here? If you don't mind, I can look into it」

name: Synn
message: 「Please do」

name: Melilot
message: 「He's gone home」

name: Azel
message: 「Th-Thank you. For, uh... not telling him I was here」

name: Melilot
message: 「What happened?」

name: Azel
message: 「There's nothing going on between Synn and me」

name: Melilot
message: 「It doesn't look that way to me」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Shut up」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san. Can't I be of help?」

name: Azel
message: 「Huh... what do you mean?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm neither a student nor directly involved in whatever is going on between you and him. That's why I simply thought it wouldn't hurt for you to talk to me about your problems」

name: Melilot
message: 「Talking to someone won't necessarily solve things, of course, but it can lighten the load on your heart」

name: Melilot
message: 「I know it may be presumptuous of me, so please just keep it in mind」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm sorry」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. We need to talk」
Did he fall asleep?

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Azel」
Oh well. I'll do it tomorrow morning.
If I wake up a little early, I should be able to catch him.
